content:
Overview

Idaho Falls is a city in ID with a population of 62,000. Eastern Idaho city on the Snake River near Yellowstone with a strong nuclear research sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.5.
